ACTION=A2
Rationale: A pedestrian is actively crossing the ego vehicle's path at a forward distance of approximately 25.8 meters. Given the ego vehicle's initial speed of 30 kph (approx. 8.33 m/s), the time to reach the conflict point is roughly 3.1 seconds. The pedestrian, moving laterally at 1.8 m/s from a starting position of -4.0 m, will be in the immediate vicinity of the ego vehicle's lane during this interval. To ensure safety and avoid a collision, the ego vehicle must decelerate (A2) to yield to the crossing pedestrian.
